SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

2. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.
   B. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.
   B. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   B. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.

7. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   D. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   C. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   C. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   C. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   C. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historical information as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   B. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   D. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   C. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.

15. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.

   C. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Developments in Medium of trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
